finding.claim: Path traversal in /dl: the user-controlled `f` query parameter is joined to /srv/files with filepath.Join, which collapses `..` but does not confine the result to root. There is no containment check, so any readable file on the host can be fetched.
finding.sink: os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, name)) at files.go:13, response written at files.go:18

trace.note: Join("/srv/files", "../../etc/passwd") cleans to /etc/passwd and ReadFile reads it
file contents returned to the caller

finding.guards_checked: No prefix or containment check, no Base(), no Rel() check and no auth. filepath.Join only calls Clean, which resolves `..` and so enables the escape. /avatar uses filepath.Base and is safe.

verdict.reason: files.go:12-13 passes the raw `f` query value to filepath.Join("/srv/files", name) and os.ReadFile with no Base/Rel/prefix check, no auth is applied at the /dl route (files.go:32), and the contents are written back at files.go:18, so `../../etc/passwd` escapes the root.
